checks: Four bounded checkpoint/preimage/allocation oracles with independent rejected mutations.
cost: Load scales with graph/index size. Current retained-material lookup hashes teaching bytes per stored lesson: O(lesson_count * material_bytes). Exam inference/parsing require measurements.
description: Retained checkpoint and material boundaries with nested envelope, source-link, kind-provenance, digest-reuse and frontier models; bounded synthetic validation evidence, no successful exam or learning-quality claim.
forward: Training maps S,L to retained S'; repeated identical material is recognized.
Assessment identity H(course,lesson_id,tests,exams) follows the scored inputs.
Exam returns scored rows without changing the learned-state fingerprint.
inverse: Teaching at exam, stale source versions, malformed checkpoints and unbound assessment reuse are excluded by named gates.
Changing only file/title must not alter assessment identity; changing scored questions/labels/option order/seed must change the tested identity.
limitations: Checksums do not authenticate testimony; public mutable state can violate assumptions; successful cold exam, I/O faults and semantic knowledge quality remain untested.
state: (course, teaching-version ledger, graph frames, aliases, role weights, assessment inputs)
